items.text: kal kar lena
thik hai
shaam ko call karna
kal hi karenge
shaam 7 baje karna
fir call karna
mujhe kal subah call karna please
kya aap mujhe agle hafte call kar sakte ho
main ab busy hoon kal baad mein baat karenge
aap shaam 6 baje ke baad call kar lena
mera number 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1 0 hai mujhe call karna
kal mujhe phone karna subah 10 baje ke aas paas
aaj main available nahi hu aap mujhe kal phone karna

items.context: Kya main abhi call karu aapko?
items.text: kal subah nal call kar lena mujhe thoda time chahiye

items.context: Kya mujhe abhi call karna hai?
items.text: bheja gaya message receive nahi hua kal phir call kar lena
shaam ke 7 baje ke baad call karna main tab free hounga

items.context: Kis time call karna prefer karenge?
items.text: main aaj busy hu kal dopahar ko call karna barah baje
mera account number hai 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 call mujhe kal karna
meri payment mein dikkat aa rahi hai isliye aap kal dobara call kar lena
abhi main baat nahi kar paunga thoda busy hu kal contact kar lena
mujhe refund ka update chahiye par abhi time nahi hai call kal kar lena
kal main ghar par milunga to tabhi baat karna aaj nahi chalega
mujhe abhi apne phone par kuch kaam karna hai kal contact kar lena
aap mujhe 28 march ko shaam ke 5 baje call kar lena please
abhi main bahar hu kal subah 9 baje call kar lena mujhe baat karni hai

items.context: Kya abhi call karna chahte hain?
items.text: aapne poocha abhi baat karni hai ya nahi main bol raha hu kal kar lena
mujhe thodi madad chahiye thi lekin abhi busy hoon kal contact karna

items.context: Main abhi call karu aapko ya baad mein?
items.text: call karne ke liye mujhe kal subah 10 baje tak intezar karna padega

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: callback_request - asks the agent to call back at another time
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
